title: Design System: Eagle Cement Gate Authorization

body.purpose: Default text — tables, forms, descriptions (Work Sans).

mono.purpose: Machine codes only — EPC / tag / event IDs.

narrative.overview: This is the interface of an authoritative, auditable register. Every truck that touches the gate becomes a row in the record — a result, a timeline, a set of snapshots. The system's job is to make that record legible and trustworthy. The palette is anchored by a single deep ledger blue on a near-white page; blue carries structure while the body stays calm, and color beyond that is reserved almost entirely for state. The feel is refined and restrained: PrimeNG components used straight, flat surfaces defined by hairline borders rather than shadow.
keyCharacteristics: One deep-blue spine on a near-white page; color spent on state, not decoration.
Flat surfaces, hairline borders; shadow reserved for overlays.
PrimeNG-first components, one vocabulary across every screen.
Monospace strictly for machine codes; human text never mono.

rules.name: The Deep-Blue Spine Rule
rules.body: Exactly one blue (#0B4EA2) anchors structure — headers, primary actions, active nav. The page body stays near-white. Do not introduce a second brand hue.

rules.name: The Status-Carries-Meaning Rule
rules.body: Color beyond the blue spine is spent on state only: green/red/amber via p-tag severities and primary-action emphasis. If a color isn't communicating a status or a primary action, it shouldn't be there.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Machine Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved exclusively for machine codes (EPC/tag/event IDs). Human-readable text is never set in mono.

rules.name: The Flat-Ledger Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow is permission to float — used only for overlays (dialogs, the auth card).

rules.name: The PrimeNG-First Rule
rules.body: Reach for the PrimeNG component before building a custom control. Style with Tailwind utilities and theme tokens; keep overrides minimal.

rules.name: The Near-Sharp Rule
rules.body: Corners are near-sharp: 2px (--radius / rounded-sm) on controls and surfaces, 0 for full-bleed structural surfaces. Never rounded-lg/xl (8px+). The base is set once in the PrimeNG preset so components and Tailwind surfaces agree. Genuinely circular indicators (status dots, timeline nodes, spinners) stay round.

rules.name: The Square-Avatar Rule
rules.body: Avatars and photo thumbnails are square (near-sharp), never circles or pills.

dos: Do anchor structure with the single Ledger Blue (#0B4EA2) and keep the page near-white (#F8FBFF).
Do spend color on state: use the canonical p-tag severity mapping for every status, and pair color with a text label.
Do set machine codes (EPC / tag / event IDs) in monospace; keep human text in Work Sans.
Do keep surfaces flat with 1px #DBE5F0 borders; reserve shadow for overlays.
Do keep corners near-sharp (2px / rounded-sm) and avatars square (shape=square).
Do use --text-muted (#55707F / text-muted) for secondary and field labels — never low-opacity body text, which fails AA.
Do present record facts as a definition list and consolidate related rows into one divide-y container.
Do reach for a PrimeNG component first; keep one vocabulary across screens.
Do keep motion restrained and state-only, with a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce fallback.
Do keep body text at or above 4.5:1 contrast — bump slate toward ink rather than fading it for elegance.
donts: Don't use consumer-SaaS cliches: no gradient text, no glassmorphism, no glossy purple, no big-number hero-metric template.
Don't drift to legacy gov/ERP clutter — tiny fonts and grey density for its own sake.
Don't build a dark security HUD: no neon-on-black, no sci-fi terminal drama.
Don't add playful/startup-cute touches — no mascots, candy colors, or emoji.
Don't use border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a decorative colored stripe on cards, callouts, or alerts (the sidebar's 2px active indicator is the one sanctioned exception).
Don't introduce a second brand hue or a new font family; the system is two fonts and one blue spine.
Don't use rounded-lg/xl (8-12px) on surfaces, or circle/pill avatars — corners stay near-sharp, avatars stay square.
Don't use uppercase-tracked labels outside nav section headers and badges, or stack individually-bordered rows — both make record views feel scattered.
Don't use the retired bright #FF4B4B or text-red-500 for text — use --destructive (#C2261B), which is AA-safe.
Don't convey pass/fail/anomaly by color alone.
